scope: Proposition G.5 (Large two-slot Seshadri constant) of the manuscript “Conditional good minimal models for compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Conditional-good-minimal-models-for-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eebddaadef6935c3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 122. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed sufficiently small ϵ > 0, there is an integer q > 0 such that, for all sufficiently small rational t > 0 and r as in Equation (203), the positive part P of Equation (209) has ε(P; x) > 2n + 2 at a very general smooth point of its torus open. In particular, for some sufficiently divisible integer k > 0, the complete system |kP| separates jets of order strictly greater than (2n + 2)k at such a point. The section spaces and these general-point jets agree on the original bundle and on common birational resolutions.
